info: Questions: Portuguese does not use an equivalent of English “did.” The verb itself is conjugated in the pretérito perfeito: Você bebeu alguma coisa? (“Did you drink something?”). Já (“already”) is commonly used for “yet” in a positive question: Você já comeu?
